## Objective

This notebook tests whether the movement metrics differ between the `P` and `SZ` groups.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
dir.create("../results", showWarnings = FALSE)

source("../sources/stat_helpers.R")
source("../sources/movement_statistics.R")
```

```{r}
movement_features <- read_csv(
  "../data/all_participants_movement_features.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

movement_group_differences <- build_movement_group_differences(movement_features)

print(movement_group_differences)
```

```{r}
write_csv(movement_group_differences, "../results/movement_group_differences.csv")
```
